assessment: Positive control accepted; negative control failed to produce a valid evidence-backed blocked report. The guardrail rejected both invalid reports, preventing their acceptance.
observations: Negative preflight and reviewer verification passed 41/49 checks; security passed.
The reviewer correctly noticed missing whitespace trimming but fabricated literal quotations by reformatting structured evidence.
Claims about lost completion state and database isolation were not established by the cited title mismatches. The SQL parameterization claim was unsupported.
The positive report referred to a document/plan despite reviewing an implementation; a correct verdict alone does not establish thorough source review.
recommendation: Use stable IDs for check evidence and attach exact evidence in code. Require reviewers to distinguish observed mismatches from inferred root causes. Retain a bounded correction and repeat these controls before another full lifecycle trial.
limitations: One positive and one negative fixture, not broad model reliability evidence.
Citation checks prove reference validity, not semantic correctness.
Reviewer-only evaluation; no writer or full lifecycle stages execute.
